title: Nashville STUDIO  Sleeps 4 Near Downtown ★★★★★
description:
This studio makes for a perfect getaway. With 2 queen beds, a full bathroom and your own kitchen, it's absolutely ideal for a solo traveler or a family that is looking for a convenient location in Nashville. Perfect if you want to be close to the hustle and bustle of Nashville but not right in the middle of it. Excellent  for business travelers or if you just want to enjoy Nashville's nightlife. Comfortable and stylish we go that extra mile so you feel at home.

The space
This cozy and astounding studio has everything you need for a fully facilitated stay. It is supplied with a full kitchen, washer, dryer smart Tv and super high speed internet. It’s the ideal for a overnight or business traveler, located 10 minutes away from down town and 15 min to the airport.

Guest access
This studio is adjacent to my home, however you have your own entry and bathroom, it is completely independent to the main house.

Other things to note
Please note this a STUDIO, not a 2 bedroom apartment. it is adjacent to my home and there is a door that divides both units that remains locked during your stay. I live in the other side of the property. This listing is just for the Studio.
